Block new ClassEnrollment and ClassEnrollmentRequest records for held periods (error :enrollment_is_held via EnrollmentHold.hold_in_date): missing

justificativa: The candidate only auto-destroys registered class enrollments when a hold is created, whereas the official fix rejects such holds, invalidates enrollment requests and blocks enrollments during held periods, so most required behaviors are missing or contradicted.
